fusions.name: Maul at a Run
fusions.desc: A heavy blow that deals 30 damage and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 25%).

fusions.name: Roar That Staggers
fusions.desc: A roar in a cone 5 tiles long that deals 12 damage to everything in it, stuns them for 1 second and leaves them [Weakened] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Hackles Up
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 20% for 12 seconds, and you move 15% faster for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Roused From Torpor
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (27% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
